Opus 5.5 x Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS is insane

It made the release video for my new SEO tool "Kotosearch" almost automatically.
All I did was "log in to the tool" and "approve".

Personally, the part where it even takes the screenshots automatically feels like it crossed a line.
(Of course the narration is so natural it's amazing too..)

The specific steps go like this 👇
1. Claude logs in to the tool in the browser
(this is the only part I did myself)

2. Claude uses the app and writes a feature specification
It organizes features, pricing, and even expressions that must not be said

3. Claude takes screenshots of the tool's screens
38 images across PC, phone and cropped parts

4. Claude writes the storyboard and narration script

5. Claude implements the video in Remotion
It looks at the stills it exports itself, and even fixes cut-off and overlapping text

6. Generate the narration audio with Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
Claude operates both the voice settings and entering the script

7. Claude splits the audio into 32 phrases
It syncs automatically so the screen and captions appear the moment it is spoken

8. Claude composes the BGM in code
It automatically lowers the volume under the voice

9. A 52-second video is complete

And so, the SEO tool "Kotosearch" officially releases on October 4.
Just enter a keyword and it produces an SEO article, and even sorts out the internal links across the whole site.
Look forward to tomorrow's release!!!
